Title: Azure Cosmos DB—New metrics and heatmaps

Body.Content:
We’re happy to announce the availability of new metrics and heatmaps in Azure Cosmos DB. You will now be able to easily detect and troubleshoot “hot partition” issues, so you can navigate from the throttling signal to partition heatmaps, and see individual records for the problematic partition key, in just two clicks. You will get full visibility into per-region usage performance against throughput, availability, latency, and consistency SLAs. Learn more about this announcement by visiting this blog post.

Read about monitoring and debugging with metrics in Azure Cosmos DB.
